subject: Data Engineering
title: Why Warehouses Exist
description: A fast breakdown of Why Warehouses Exist for builders.

hook.text: Production databases serve apps. But running analytics on them slows down the app for everyone.

buildup.text: In the 1980s, companies started copying data into a separate system optimized for analysis.

discovery.text: That separate system became the data warehouse — a central store designed for fast, complex queries.

twist.text: Warehouses don't replace databases. They exist so databases can do their job without interruption.

climax.text: Every major company now runs analytics on a warehouse, not on their production database.

punchline.text: One system for apps. Another for answers.

quiz.question: Why were data warehouses invented?
options: To run analytics without slowing down production databases
